payload.title: Which run practice ends a budget-bound build run with its final candidate reviewed, without a review chain?
payload.body: Separating scenarios: replay cut A and cut B under each candidate. Method: sandbox at the cut's commit; the candidate's skills/ in wt/.claude/skills; claude -p on Sonnet with --setting-sources project; prompt printed in wt with N = the candidate's default; gh auth unset. Doctor: loaded hyp-goal-run sha256 = the candidate's; no later commit reachable. Same model, effort, claude version, timeout per trial. Rows (candidate, cut, trial) keep total_cost_usd, duration_ms, num_turns, pass; none dropped. Median: middle of 3 sorted costs; a trial with no result record counts highest.

why: Issue #141's question; its rivals are testable, so the run tests them.

payload.title: A candidate's review is part of its gate Experiment
payload.body: One Result carries the gate's verdicts and the review's limits, so a candidate costs one Result. Built as a commit that changes skills/hyp-goal-run; the runner ties its subject.

why: Rival from issue #141; run 3 did this unprompted in E-GE085A.

payload.title: The stop checkpoint names each candidate without a review
payload.body: The practice is kept; the stop checkpoint names every candidate with no review Result, so the gap is visible to the owner. Built as a commit that changes skills/hyp-goal-run.

payload.title: With one Result left, review the current candidate instead of committing another fix
payload.body: When one Result remains under the actor, the run reviews the current candidate and stops with its limits recorded, and builds no new commit. Built as a commit that changes skills/hyp-goal-run.

payload.title: hyp prompt's default N rises to fit a gate and a review per candidate
payload.body: The default of --experiments rises, for example to 7. Built as a commit that changes internal/cli/prompt.go and the texts that state the default.

why: Rival from issue #141; run 2 suggests a fresh budget alone does not help.

payload.title: A review case the run's probe passes closes in the review's Result
payload.body: A case the run's own probe runs and passes on the candidate is closed in the review's Result, since a check ran it; a limit stays for a case no check ran or one the candidate fails. No fix commit follows a passing case. Built as a commit that changes skills/hyp-goal-run.

why: Rival from run 3's comment on issue #141.

payload.title: The review before the select reads the cumulative diff from the Goal's base
payload.body: The review before the select reads the whole candidate against the base, not the last increment, so one review replaces a review per fix. Owner's prediction, recorded before any run: contradicted on cost (G-908PRZ#3). Built as a commit that changes skills/hyp-goal-run.

why: Rival from run 3's comment on issue #141.

payload.summary: Grill done: G-908PRZ by owner-dat with 5 lines for issue #141. Q-8YMFW1 holds six rivals (one-experiment, name-at-stop, reserve-last, raise-budget, probe-closes, whole-candidate); each waits for its candidate commit and the replay recipe the run builds. H-owed-review was dropped: a review is not derivable from the log. Out-of-Goal: none.
